GOOD QUESTIONS

Before we get
to work.

How much does stump grinding cost?+

Pricing depends on the stump’s size, root flare, wood condition, access, grinding depth, and cleanup. Send photos and measurements for a preliminary estimate. Final pricing is confirmed after reviewing the job.

Are wood chips and branches hauled away?+

Cleanup and haul-away are discussed with your estimate. For stump grinding, let us know whether you want the grindings left onsite or removed. Soil, sod, and other restoration are not automatically included.

Does grinding remove the entire root system?+

No. Grinding reduces the agreed stump area below ground level; roots beyond that area can remain. Tell us if you’re planning construction or replanting in the same spot so the required scope can be reviewed.

Can you quote tree removal from a photo?+

Photos are a useful starting point, but tree condition, overhead lines, nearby buildings, and equipment access can require an onsite assessment before a final quote.

Do you work with other tree companies?+

Yes. Contact us about stump-grinding referrals, follow-up work, or overflow jobs. We’ll discuss the scope, scheduling, and billing arrangement before accepting the work.
